pages.text: $(thing)Tea Saplings$() can be planted in the ground to grow a $(thing)Tea Bush$() — a two-block-tall seasonal plant. The bush goes through lifecycle stages (dormant, healthy, flowering, fruiting) based on climate and season. Right-click a fruiting bush to harvest fresh tea leaves.

If a tea bush is left unharvested for 2 years, it transforms irreversibly into a $(thing)Tea Tree$() — a full fruit tree with branches and leaves. Trees yield more leaves but cannot be reverted to bushes.$(br2)Tea saplings can also be placed in a $(l:firmalife/planters)Bonsai Planter$() in a greenhouse, where they grow as a tree directly.

$(thing)Coffee Trees$() grow exclusively as fruit trees. Wild coffee trees in the world must grow for 2 years before first fruiting. In a bonsai planter, they fruit immediately.$(br2)Coffee cherries can be eaten as a small fruit snack, but their real value is in processing them into coffee.
